notice: A new version of TransTeira is available: {version}.
title: Version
latestNone: Unknown: no check has succeeded yet.
upToDate: This instance is up to date.
procedure: TransTeira never updates itself. Read the CHANGELOG and follow the update procedure in the documentation, which verifies the image signature before updating.
disabled: The check for new versions is disabled. To enable it, remove TT_UPDATE_CHECK=false from the server environment and restart the application.
disabledNow: The update check has just been disabled on this server.
resultUpToDate: Check finished: this instance is up to date.
rateLimited: Checking too often. Please wait a moment before trying again.
loadError: The version status could not be loaded.

error.network: The last attempt failed: GitHub is unreachable (network, timeout or certificate).
error.http: The last attempt failed: GitHub answered with an unexpected status.
error.parse: The last attempt failed: the answer from GitHub could not be read.
